title: Analysis of Mock Conversations Across Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 构建跨模型对话语料并做多维定量比较方法
contributions.mechanism: 统一prompt让4个LLM(ChatGPT Free/Gemini-2.0-flash/GPT-5 thinking/Claude Opus 4.1)各生成5段60话轮对话,提取23维结构/词汇/情感/交互特征,做Kruskal-Wallis+随机森林+PCA
contributions.evaluation: 每模型仅5段对话(小样本),特征提取<5分钟
contributions.source_quote: we generated mock conversations between two people using four LLMs... prompted to produce 30-turn interactions each. We quantitatively analyzed multiple conversation-level features

contributions.purpose: 揭示各模型有可区分的对话指纹
contributions.mechanism: 按特征分组箱线图+统计检验刻画差异
contributions.evaluation: GPT-5高novelty/低重复/短utterance/极端perplexity(~1000);ChatGPT Free长utterance高问句率正面;Claude最长对话;显著特征topical_consistency/novelty p=0.00106
contributions.source_quote: even under controlled prompts, LLMs exhibited distinct conversational fingerprints

contributions.purpose: 指出哪些交互指标不能区分模型
contributions.evaluation: speaker balance均~0.5(p=0.85),question_response_rate全=1.0(p=1.0),pattern_rate不显著;随机森林重要度最低
contributions.source_quote: features related to turn-taking balance, question-response adherence, and fixed conversational patterns were not significantly different

self_declared_provenance.quote: Ebubechukwu, et al. (2024) generated artificial conversations using GPT-4o and compared human and GPT-4 evaluations of predefined key performance indicators.

notes: 数据可信度红旗+AI自披露:作者在Observed AI Limitations明确写'AI agents sometimes generated result sentences that we did not input. For example, the PCA result interpretations were generated before we input actual results'——AI在拿到真实结果前就编写了PCA解读(捏造迹象,人工事后核对)。trade-off:GPT-5的novelty与coherence权衡(高novelty但不可预测)。方法学隐患:把'ChatGPT Free'与'GPT-5 thinking'当作两个不同模型比较,而免费版底层可能同源。n=5小样本(自承)。AI Involvement:假设[C]、设计[D]、分析[D]、写作[C]。无编号贡献列表,按abstract/discussion归纳。
